sloka: इष्टं मधुवनं ह्येतत् सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः ।पितृपैतामहं दिव्यं देवैरपि दुरासदम् ।। ५.६२.३३ ।।।।
transliteration: iṣṭaṁ madhuvanaṁ hyetat sugrīvasya mahātmanaḥ ।pitṛpaitāmahaṁ divyaṁ devairapi durāsadam ।। 5.62.33 ।।।।

translations.english: 'Madhuvan has come down to us from our forefather's time. Dear to the king, its entry is prohibited even to the gods.
